jobs.title: What you can do with integrations.
jobs.intro: Start from the job you want done. Each one lists the apps that make it work.

items.title: Track orders and deliveries
items.body: Answer "where is my order" with the real order and delivery status, including five Indian shipping carriers.

items.title: Sell and check out in the chat
items.body: Recommend products that are in stock, mention only live discounts and send customers to checkout.

items.title: Bring customers back
items.body: Switch on ready-made workflows for abandoned carts, COD confirmation, review requests and win-back.

items.title: Book appointments

items.title: Capture and pass on leads

items.title: Answer from your documents

custom.title: Using a tool that is not listed?
custom.body: Ask us about a custom integration. Tell us what it should do and our team will look at it with you.

items.q: Do I need an integration to get started?
items.a: No. Your agent can answer from your website, files and FAQs from day one. Integrations add actions such as order lookups and bookings.

items.q: How do I connect an app?
items.a: Open Resources, then Apps, and connect the app to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. Both steps are needed before an agent uses it.

items.q: Do I connect apps again for each agent?
items.a: No. Apps are workspace resources. Connect once and choose which agents use them.
Integrations are available on paid plans. The Free plan does not include channel integrations, order tracking or human handoff.
